snippets.label: Timing Signals (Robust / Concise / Binary)
snippets.description: Define clock, signal, and state waveforms
snippets.code:
robust "{cursor}Radio State" as RS
concise "NAS State" as NS
binary "Clock / Strobe" as CLK

@0
RS is IDLE
NS is DEREGISTERED
CLK is low

@100
RS is TX_ACTIVE
NS is REGISTERING
CLK is high

snippets.label: Packetdiag Octet Fields
snippets.description: Define protocol message header bit fields
snippets.code:
packetdiag {
  colwidth = 32
  node_height = 40

  0-7: {cursor}Protocol Discriminator
  8-15: Security Header Type
  16-31: Message Authentication Code (MAC)
  32-39: Sequence Number
  40-63: Payload [colheight = 2]
}
